positions.title: Linux Systems Administrator Intern
positions.description:
Improved hosting server performance by dedensifying GoDaddy’s filer cluster.
Automated filer storage report creation using Ruby.

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description:
Wrote bash scripts to help with the migration from an oblix single sign-on system to an F5 APM system.
Assisted various web development teams with deployments to Southwest’s apache/tomcat environment.

positions.title: Co-founder
positions.description: Co-developed Onvard.com with classmate, wrote Ruby, HTML, CSS and Javascript.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Migrated squidGuard from old physical Red Hat environment to a new Ubuntu Virtual Machine.
Updated Active Directory Group Policies to discern between Windows 7 and XP. 
Devised a Windows SCCM development environment with various virtual machines to experiment with software and OS deployments.

positions.title: Vice President of Information Technology
positions.description:
Maintain the asudisc.org website for the club.
Created a resume book website for club members in Ruby on Rails.

positions.title: Developer Intern
positions.description:
Brought in deployment date for the Identity Manager application by one month by fixing GUI issues with Seam and adding logic that would reduce the amount of duplicate contractors entered into the system.
Developed web application to ensure the timely removal of network access for dismissed employees in Java and Seam.
